 COPILOT

```{r}
#install.packages("igraph")
#install.packages("ggraph")
#install.packages("tidyverse")

library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Define nodes edges

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r }
# Define nodes
nodes <- data.frame(
  id = c(
    "Networks and Trees", "Vertices or Edges Might Have Attributes",
    "Edge: Directed or Undirected", "Relevant Data Structures",
    "Height or Radius Encoding Depth in the Tree", "Layout Algorithms for Networks",
    "Adjacency Matrix Views", "Visualization of Hierarchical Structure Using Containment",
    "Internet", "Evolutionary Tree", "Disease Transmission",
    "Physical Interactions", "Conceptual Relationships",
    "Treemap", "Cavet"
  ),
  group = c("Abstract", "Abstract", "Abstract", "Abstract", "Abstract", "Abstract",
            "Abstract", "Abstract", "Practical", "Practical", "Practical",
            "Task", "Task", "Visualization", "Visualization")
)

# Define edges
edges <- data.frame(
  from = c(
    "Networks and Trees", "Networks and Trees", "Networks and Trees",
    "Networks and Trees", "Networks and Trees", "Networks and Trees",
    "Networks and Trees", "Networks and Trees",
    "Relevant Data Structures", "Vertices or Edges Might Have Attributes",
    "Vertices or Edges Might Have Attributes", "Visualization of Hierarchical Structure Using Containment",
    "Visualization of Hierarchical Structure Using Containment", "Networks and Trees",
    "Networks and Trees", "Networks and Trees"
  ),
  to = c(
    "Vertices or Edges Might Have Attributes", "Edge: Directed or Undirected",
    "Relevant Data Structures", "Height or Radius Encoding Depth in the Tree",
    "Layout Algorithms for Networks", "Adjacency Matrix Views",
    "Visualization of Hierarchical Structure Using Containment", "Internet",
    "Adjacency Matrix Views", "Edge: Directed or Undirected",
    "Physical Interactions", "Treemap", "Cavet", "Evolutionary Tree",
    "Disease Transmission", "Conceptual Relationships"
  )
)
```

create graph


```{r}
graph <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, vertices = nodes, directed = TRUE)
graph
print(nodes)
```

plot concept map

```{r}
ggraph(graph, layout = "fr") +  # Fruchterman-Reingold layout for clarity
  geom_edge_link(aes(label = NA), arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, 'mm')), end_cap = circle(3, 'mm'), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = group), size = 5) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label =nodes$id), repel = TRUE, size = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Concept Map: Trees and Networks",
       subtitle = "Exploring abstract concepts and practical examples",
       color = "Group")

```

`GTP 2`


```{r}
# Load libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(ggforce)
library(tibble)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

# Define nodes
nodes <- tribble(
  ~id, ~label, ~x, ~y,
  "A", "Networks and Trees", 0, 0,
  "B", "Examples:\nInternet,\nEvolutionary Tree,\nDisease Transmission", -4, 2,
  "C", "Node & Edge Attributes:\nDirected, Weighted, Labels", -4, -2,
  "D", "Data Structures:\nAdjacency Matrix / List", 2, 2,
  "E", "Related Tasks:\nPhysical / Conceptual", 2, -2,
  "F", "Layout:\nRadial, Force-Directed", 4, 0,
  "G", "Encoding Depth:\nHeight / Radius", 0, -4,
  "H", "Containment Hierarchy:\nTreemap, Cavet, Circle Packing", -2, -6,
  "I", "Adjacency Matrix Views:\nBlock / Cluster Structure", 4, 4
)

# Define edges
edges <- tribble(
  ~from, ~to, ~label,
  "A", "B", "modeled with",
  "A", "C", "composed of",
  "A", "D", "represented using",
  "A", "E", "used in",
  "A", "F", "visualized via",
  "A", "G", "for Trees",
  "A", "H", "tree visualization using",
  "A", "I", "alternate view",
  "H", "G", "encodes depth via area/nesting",
  "I", "D", "matrix form of",
  "C", "F", "affects visual layout"
)

# Join coordinates for edge drawing
edges_coords <- edges %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("from" = "id")) %>%
  rename(x_start = x, y_start = y) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("to" = "id")) %>%
  rename(x_end = x, y_end = y)

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = edges_coords, 
               aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), 
               color = "gray30") +
  geom_label_repel(data = nodes, 
                   aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
                   fill = "lightblue", color = "black", size = 3.5,
                   fontface = "bold", box.padding = 0.5,
                   point.padding = 0.3, segment.color = NA) +
  geom_text(data = edges_coords,
            aes(x = (x_start + x_end)/2, y = (y_start + y_end)/2, label = label),
            size = 3, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -0.5, color = "black") +
  theme_void() +
  ggtitle("Concept Map: Trees and Networks") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))

```
